set.body:
Outcome

Record the binding architectural decision before implementation.

Acceptance

- Defines identified axes, observations, partitioned relations, measurement frames, distinct designs, open estimands, scientific versus execution identity, and typed results.
- Records two sibling kernels and repository ownership.
- Forbids compatibility namespaces, central analysis enums, universal Response or FoldPlan, hidden materialization, and learned measurements without fit scope.
- Names the two vertical slices and final deletion gate.
set.title: P0.1: write and ratify the unified MVPA architecture constitution
